module.name: speak
module.description: Inline speakable text: renders its body inline with a small play mark; clicking speaks it with machine TTS (window.mdpTts) and highlights the words as they are read. The lightweight sibling of @speakcard (no translation/reading-note rows).
module.aiSpec:
Wrap a phrase or sentence INSIDE running text to make it speakable: the body renders inline (with a small ▶ mark before it), clicking it reads it aloud via the app's TTS (window.mdpTts) with read-along word highlighting; clicking again stops. Use @speakcard instead when you want the full card (sentence + smaller translation + reading note). Undecorated by design — the text keeps its surrounding style. Cross-surface: clicking on the presenter/remote plays the audio on the OWNER surface (slideshow / preview); the mark and highlight stay in sync everywhere. With `tag: NAME` a @script can play it via `[[emit-wait: cmd:NAME play | ラベル]]` (see @speakcard).
Gotcha: declared as a block module but renders INLINE, so it flows within the surrounding sentence. The body is the spoken text (inline Markdown allowed); the spoken string is the body's plain text.
Parameters: • lang (text, default en-US) — BCP-47 language; picks the narrator automatically. • engine (auto | webspeech | server | voicevox, default auto) — who reads it: auto = the app's narrator for the language; server = the TTS server set in the app; voicevox = local VOICEVOX. • voice (text, default '') — the voice for that engine: Web Speech narrator name (substring ok, e.g. Zira; with auto it implies Web Speech), the TTS server's voice id, or a VOICEVOX style id; `@name` = a voice preset saved in the app (overrides engine; read by language where missing). • prompt (text, default '') — engine server only: how to speak (voice description / instructions). • extra (text, default '') — engine server only: the TTS server's own options as name=value pairs, e.g. `extra: "cfg_weight=0.3"` (see @speakcard's mainextra). • pitch / intonation / volume (number, default blank) — engine voicevox only: pitchScale (-0.15–0.15), intonationScale (0–2), volumeScale (0–2). • speaker (number, default -1) — older form: VOICEVOX style id when lang is Japanese and the engine is auto (-1 = not used). • rate (number, default 1) — speaking rate (0.5–2). • fallback (auto | webspeech | none, default auto) — when the engine cannot speak: the app's narrator (if another engine that speaks the language), then Web Speech / Web Speech only / stay silent. The tooltip then says what happened. • highlight (boolean, default true) — highlight the words as they are spoken. • icon (boolean, default true) — show the small ▶ mark before the text.
Example: The verb <!-- @speak lang: en-US -->**boils**<!-- @end --> is in the present tense. Full sentence: <!-- @speak rate: 0.9 -->Water boils at 100 °C.<!-- @end --> VOICEVOX: <!-- @speak lang: ja-JP, engine: voicevox, voice: 3 -->沸騰する<!-- @end -->

param.name: lang
param.label: Language
param.desc: BCP-47 language of the text (picks the narrator), e.g. en-US, ja-JP.

param.name: engine
param.label: Speaker: engine
param.options: auto:Auto (by language / the app's narrator),webspeech:Web Speech (browser),server:TTS server,voicevox:VOICEVOX
param.desc: Who reads it. Auto = the app's narrator for the language.

param.name: voice
param.label: Speaker: voice
param.desc: Web Speech narrator name, the TTS server's voice id, a VOICEVOX style id, or @name for a saved preset — pick from the list or type. Blank = the engine's default.

param.name: prompt
param.label: Speaker: prompt
param.desc: How the TTS server should speak (Irodori: voice description; OpenAI-type servers: instructions). Blank = the app's setting.

param.name: extra
param.label: Speaker: server options
param.desc: The TTS server's own options (e.g. Chatterbox's accent cfg_weight), written name=value, … — only those the server takes are sent. Blank = the app's setting.

param.name: pitch
param.label: Speaker: pitch
param.desc: VOICEVOX pitchScale (-0.15 to 0.15). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: intonation
param.label: Speaker: intonation
param.desc: VOICEVOX intonationScale (0 to 2). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: volume
param.label: Speaker: volume
param.desc: VOICEVOX volumeScale (0 to 2). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: speaker
param.label: VOICEVOX speaker (older form)
param.desc: VOICEVOX style id when the language is Japanese and the engine is Auto (-1 = not used).

param.name: fallback
param.label: If the engine cannot speak
param.options: auto:The app's narrator then Web Speech,webspeech:Web Speech,none:Stay silent
param.desc: Used when the chosen engine is not running, not set up, or lacks the voice. The tooltip says what happened.

param.name: highlight
param.label: Read-along highlight
param.desc: Highlight the words as they are spoken.

param.name: icon
param.label: Play mark
param.desc: Show the small play mark before the text.

snippet.label: Speakable text (inline)
snippet.description: Inline text that speaks on click, with read-along highlight.

snippet.label: Speakable text (named narrator)
snippet.description: Speak a word/phrase with a named narrator (e.g. Zira).
